case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost environment so clearly. We understand that alloy and input costs have moved, and we take that seriously.

Our own purchase history and performance data give a somewhat different picture:

Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

On that basis, we have prepared three options. Each offers a longer contract term than your proposal, which gives you planning security, and Option C keeps your preferred payment terms:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.54; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.38; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.50; no index clause; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months.

If your pricing committee needs any further detail to review these, we will gladly provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Indeed, we have reviewed the historical pricing and delivery data you provided, which we acknowledge and have factored into our revised proposal.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. We are willing to build on your Option C by extending the contract term to 24 months; however, a fixed price over this duration is not feasible, requiring the addition of an AS-14404 index clause. By incorporating this index clause to manage the extended risk, we can reduce the base price to EUR 5.48 per unit while maintaining your preferred 30-day payment terms.

Our primary proposal is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.48 per unit. As another option, we offer a price of €5.48 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
